component.name: Trizbort (Qt)
component.summary: Map maker for interactive fiction and text adventures

description.p: Trizbort (Qt) is a cross-platform mapper for interactive fiction. Draw rooms and the connections between them, annotate them with descriptions and objects, and export the map as source code for many interactive-fiction systems (ZIL, Inform 6, Inform 7, TADS 3, Hugo, Alan, Quest and Adventuron) or as a PDF or image.
It can also build a map automatically from a play-session transcript, following the player's movements. It reads and writes the .trizbort file format used by the original Trizbort.
Initial packaged release of the Qt/C++ reimplementation.
